newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, bear-spread featured.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, bear-spread featured.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled mixed, and traders said bear-spreading between the September and July contracts was a featured activity.

"Within the last week, the July/Sept spread had widened from even money to a seven cent (per bushel) inverse, and I think the general opinion today was that seven cents was too high," a MGE trader said.

Traders said commercial support in the July/September spread was lacking and well below the level seen in recent days. They said the July/Sept spread was being offered aggressively at six cents at the close.
MGE spring wheat settled 3/4 cents per bushel lower to two cents higher, with July down 3/4 cents at $3.89-3/4. September spring wheat gained 3/4 cent to close at $3.83-1/2.
Atwood-Peavey bear-spread at least one million September/July bushels, traders said.
